channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula 4 terá fiscal “mais organizado” e juros mais baixos, diz Durigan
item.description: Finance Minister Durigan stated that a potential fourth term for Lula aims for a more structured fiscal framework, lower interest rates, and review of mandatory spending and tax benefits. He supports reforms to the fiscal framework with transparent criteria for benefits.

item.title: Brasileirão: Flamengo mantém favoritismo e tem 66% de chance de título
item.description: Flamengo maintained the lead in the 2026 Brazilian Championship with 66.2% title chances after a 2-1 victory over Corinthians at Maracanã. Palmeiras, with 32.1%, is the main contender, followed by Athletico-PR, Fluminense, and Bahia. The battle for first place remains tight, with just one point separating the top two teams.

item.title: Crise no STF pode ter ‘impacto decisivo’ nas eleições brasileiras, diz Financial Times
item.description: The Financial Times warns that the ongoing crisis at the Brazilian Supreme Court, driven by the clash between justices André Mendonça and Alexandre de Moraes, could decisively impact the 2026 presidential elections. The turmoil is eroding the court’s credibility and directly affects candidates Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, the latter mentioned in the Banco Master case.

item.title: Mendonça pretende antecipar voto para evitar blindagem de Moraes
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça intends to advance his vote on injunctions against colleague Alexandre de Moraes to prevent another minister from requesting a rehearing. This move aims to expedite the trial and reduce delays in the Master case proceedings at the STF.

item.title: Durigan sugere novo corte linear nos gastos tributários em próximo mandato de Lula
item.description: Finance Minister Durigan proposed a linear tax spending cut of 5% to 10% in a potential third Lula term, criticizing the lack of transparency in tax benefits and advocating for their annual review. He also suggested abolishing individual income tax filings and emphasized the need for a "strong state and strong market" to attract investments.

item.title: Julgamento uniu André Mendonça e Gilmar Mendes em 2025 para trancar inquérito contra Cláudio Castro
item.description: In 2025, ministers André Mendonça and Gilmar Mendes voted to suspend an inquiry against Cláudio Castro at the STF, which involved a controversial plea bargain and footage of cash delivery. The defense argued procedural irregularities, claiming jurisdictional usurpation of the STJ. The case reignited debates on ministerial conduct within the STF.

item.title: Kassio se reúne com Fachin às vésperas de sessão sobre Moraes
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques met with Edson Fachin ahead of the STF session analyzing the PF report on interactions between Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, focusing on the legality of investigations and the continuation of the probe.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest: colunistas do GLOBO analisam os resultados da corrida presidencial após a crise Master
item.description: A new Quaest poll commissioned by Grupo Globo examines how the ongoing crisis at the Supreme Court affects the presidential bids of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Felipe Nunes, identifying government approval ratings as the main hurdle for Lula to regain momentum. GLOBO columnists discuss how both campaigns are likely to escalate anti-corruption attacks, while voters can self-identify with candidates through an interactive quiz provided by the outlet.

item.title: TV Globo entrevista daqui a pouco Fernando Haddad (PT); acompanhe
item.description: TV Globo interviews Fernando Haddad (PT), first gubernatorial candidate for São Paulo, live at 12:15 PM on Monday. Broadcast on SP1 and g1, with full replay on Globoplay. Tarcísio de Freitas will be interviewed next, following a draw among parties.

item.title: A corrupção monopoliza o debate eleitoral (por Naiara Galarraga Gortázar)
item.description: Brazil's 2026 election is dominated by the Master Bank scandal, with allegations involving Flávio Bolsonaro and judge Alexandre de Moraes, shifting focus from key issues like security and economy. Corruption becomes the central theme of the campaign, with numerous politicians and institutions implicated in a web spanning the STF, PF, and political parties. The electoral landscape is marked by legal uncertainties and a deeply polarized race.

item.title: Mendonça está impedido de votar. E Kássio, pai de Kevin? E a sede de sangue
item.description: André Mendonça is barred from voting in the STF session due to conflict-of-interest rules for judges who are involved parties in a case. STF President Edson Fachin took over the rapporteurship of cases related to Alexandre de Moraes, while Kássio (father of Kevin) and other blood-related questions are mentioned metaphorically. The text discusses legal and historical aspects without directly involving the candidates.

item.title: Quaest: Preocupação com corrupção sobe de 14% para 22% em 12 dias
item.description: Concern about corruption rose from 14% to 22% in 12 days, becoming the second most cited problem in Brazil, behind only violence. The Quaest survey, conducted between September 10 and 13, interviewed 2,004 people and has a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: Escolhido por Gonet para atuar no Master divide aula com Moraes na USP
item.description: André de Carvalho Ramos, selected by Paulo Gonet as a prosecutor for the Master Case, teaches alongside Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes at USP. They co-teach the postgraduate course 'Digital Law: New Challenges of Democracy, Constitution, Rights and Development', created in May 2026, covering topics such as disinformation and electoral law.

item.title: Supremo dirá se o Brasil tem, ou não, um tribunal de confiança
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court will rule on whether Brazil has a court of cassation, a legal figure that can influence important judicial decisions. The analysis aims to verify the existence or not of a specific judicial structure in the country.

item.title: As contas dos votos dos ministros para o julgamento de Moraes no STF
item.description: The STF trial of Alexandre de Moraes, scheduled for Tuesday (9/15), will analyze the validity of the PF report on messages between Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. With a 3-3 split among justices, Cármen Lúcia's vote will be decisive, while Fachin and Toffoli may not participate.

item.title: Por dentro da rede de influenciadores que ataca o voto feminino no Brasil
item.description: A network of influencers in Brazil has been questioning women's right to vote, raising concerns in the political sphere. Supreme Court Minister Cármen Lúcia told BBC News Brasil that proposing changes to this right is unconstitutional.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest mostra avanço de Flávio Bolsonaro em região decisiva para a eleição
item.description: The Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading in the Southeast with 47% against Lula's 31% in a simulated runoff, remaining at 42% versus 40% nationally within the margin of error.

item.title: Conheça o caminho do voto, desde a seção eleitoral até a divulgação do resultado
item.description: The Brazilian electoral process begins at 7 AM with the issuance of the 'zerésima', confirming all candidates are at zero votes. Voting starts at 8 AM, where voters identify themselves using CPF or voter ID, cast their ballots, and after the 5 PM cutoff, encrypted data is sent to the TSE, where supercomputers perform the count using specialized keys, ensuring accuracy and publishing final results.

item.title: Cezinha de Madureira juntou Mendonça e Vorcaro, andou de moto com Bolsonaro e tirou foto com Lula
item.description: Cezinha de Madureira, an influential politician, met with Mendonça and Vorcaro, rode with Bolsonaro, and took a photo with Lula. André Mendonça, supported by allies, celebrated his appointment to the STF after a favorable vote.

item.title: Quaest: 44% têm mais medo de reeleição de Lula; 42%, da volta da família Bolsonaro
item.description: A Quaest/Globo poll shows 44% of voters fear Lula's reelection more than Bolsonaro's return (42%), within the technical tie. Fear of Lula's reelection is higher among evangelicals (54%), while Bolsonaro's return worries more Catholics (48%) and Northeast voters. The survey was filed with TSE with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Lula é desaprovado por 50% e aprovado por 43%, diz Quaest
item.description: A Genial/Quaest survey released on September 14, 2026, shows 50% disapproval and 43% approval of President Lula; 32% rate the administration as 'great' or 'good' and 38% as 'bad' or 'terrible'. The poll, with a 2-point margin of error and costing R$314,628, was funded by Grupo Globo and registered with the TSE.

item.title: Lula usa Alvorada em live de campanha; TSE havia proibido Bolsonaro de fazer o mesmo em 2022
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) used the Alvorada Palace for a live broadcast promoting his re-election, amid debates over the use of public spaces during campaigns. Lula's team said the broadcast used only campaign equipment and followed TSE regulations. In 2022, the TSE had barred Jair Bolsonaro (PL) from using the same location for electoral purposes.

item.title: Flávio aparece numericamente à frente no 2° turno contra Lula pela primeira vez desde abril
item.description: A Quaest poll released on September 14 shows, for the first time since April, Flávio Bolsonaro leading simulated second-round votes against President Lula (42% to 40%), within the margin of error. The survey was conducted during the Supreme Court crisis and after the Master case seal was lifted, which investigates Jair Bolsonaro's family. Flávio attempts to link Lula to Justice Minister Moraes, while other simulations keep Lula ahead or tied.

item.title: Conheça as medidas de segurança das urnas; testes começam com um ano de antecedência
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) conducts security tests on electronic voting machines in advance, including the Public Security Test, to identify vulnerabilities. The 2026 elections follow the established schedule with a series of technical validations and public audits.

item.title: Vera Magalhães: 'As duas campanhas vão intensificar ataques no terreno da corrupção'; assista à análise em vídeo
item.description: Corruption emerges as a central issue in the 2026 race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, according to Vera Magalhães. A Quaest poll shows 22% of respondents cite corruption as the main problem. Campaigns are expected to intensify attacks on this front, with mutual accusations involving the STF, Moraes, and Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: O STF pode decidir a eleição
item.description: The text discusses how the Supreme Federal Court (STF) can influence the 2026 elections, highlighting the role of judicial decisions in defining electoral rules and candidate eligibility. Thomas Traumann analyzes the weekly political scenario focusing on the intersection between the judiciary and elections.

item.title: Flávio está numericamente à frente de Lula no 2º turno, indica Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Lula (PT) in the runoff, with 42% against 40%. Last week, the candidates were tied at 41%.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP nesta segunda (14/9)
item.description: On Monday (September 14), seven candidates for São Paulo governor continue their electoral agendas on the 30th day of the 2026 campaign. Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad lead the polls, but only Haddad announced scheduled events. Candidates like Carlos Machado, Policial Edjane, Vera Lúcia, and Vivian Mendes have not disclosed their plans, while Izadora Dias will hold meetings and produce digital content. The campaign proceeds at varying paces among contenders.

item.title: Celular de Vorcaro vira disputa no STF às vésperas de sessão sobre Moraes
item.description: A dispute has emerged at the STF regarding access to the full content extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone, with ministers Zanin and Gilmar Mendes requesting the data from the PF, while Minister André Mendonça opposes its release before the trial. Tensions escalate ahead of the session analyzing Petition 16.662, linked to alleged messages between Alexandre de Moraes and Vorcaro.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos candidatos ao ao GDF nesta segunda-feira (14/9)
item.description: Candidates for the GDF hold campaign events across various regions of Brasília on Monday, with emphasis on interviews and voter interactions. Celina Leão (PP), the leading candidate in polls, suspends her schedule to care for her hospitalized mother.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro travam batalha jurídica contra acusações sem provas
item.description: TSE suspends electoral ads with unsubstantiated accusations against Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, classifying as misinformation facts without context or charges without evidence. Lawyers for the candidates are legally disputing to block contents considered fake news.

item.title: Traições à esquerda e à direita em eleição ao Senado no Rio põem sob risco aliados de Lula e de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Senate race in Rio reveals internal betrayals in both alliances: PT and Bolsonarists face resistance from their bases to consolidate votes, with divergent endorsements for left and right-wing candidates, threatening the alliance strategies of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Segurança reforçada, telão no STF e transmissão pela TV: saiba como será a sessão que pode abrir investigação contra Moraes
item.description: The STF will hold an extraordinary session with heightened security to debate potential investigation against Minister Moraes, following revelations of messages between Vorcaro and authorities during the Banco Master crisis.

item.title: Novo embate de ala de Moraes contra Mendonça por dados do celular de Vorcaro escala tensão pré-julgamento
item.description: STF ministers clash over the analysis of Daniel Vorcaro's phone, with Zanin and Gilmar ordering data delivery while Mendonça opposes it. The conflict escalates pre-trial tension and may influence debates on procedural issues in Tuesday's session. The dispute among judges reflects divergent views on transparency and secrecy in sensitive investigations.

item.title: Manifestação sobre celular de Vorcaro será mais um teste para Fachin, que tenta evitar 'tumulto' em julgamento de Moraes
item.description: The Supreme Court trial of Alexandre de Moraes faces new tensions over access to Daniel Vorcaro's phone data. Justices disagree on sharing or restricting the data, while Fachin seeks to prevent 'procedural tumult' and keeps Tuesday's hearing scheduled.

item.title: O que faz uma celebridade ser realmente influente? Grazi Massafera ajuda a entender
item.description: Grazi Massafera was elected the most influential personality in Brazil in the 2026 MIC² survey, scoring 137 points with emphasis on beauty, style, and authenticity. Conducted by Ipsos with 2,000 respondents, the research reveals that influence goes beyond follower count, valuing traits such as trust, inspiration, and political engagement. Experts emphasize that influencing means generating identification and behavioral change, not just popularity.

item.title: Com menos candidatos, SP tem eleição ao governo mais diversa do século
item.description: The 2026 election for São Paulo state government marks the highest racial and gender diversity of the century, with 42.9% of candidates being Black or Brown, including three Black or Brown women for the first time. Despite having the fewest candidates (seven), the race stands out for its representativeness, contrasting with previous elections dominated by whites and men.

item.title: No Z4 do Brasileirão, Remo leva vantagem no histórico recente contra Bahia
item.description: In the 27th round of the Brazilian Championship, Bahia and Remo face each other at Arena Fonte Nova. Remo leads the recent head-to-head with four wins against one from Bahia. However, Bahia is in 5th place with 43 points, while Remo sits in 19th, fighting relegation.

item.title: Yasmin Brunet é a modelo mais aguardada da estreia do Metrópoles Catwalk
item.description: The 2026 Metrópoles Catwalk highlighted Yasmin Brunet, who walked for the Brasília-based brands Biruta and Zinc Complements. Known for her fashion career and appearance on BBB24, the model is among the most anticipated personalities at the event.

item.title: As veias abertas do STF e os embates sobre o fim do sigilo no Caso Master - O Assunto #1803
item.description: The STF faces one of its most tense moments with disputes over the secrecy of the Master Case, involving investigations against lawmakers and politicians' relatives. The crisis reflects institutional tensions and suspicions about ministers' impartiality.

item.title: Los nietos del exilio y el derecho a votar suspendido
item.description: On September 10, 2026, the Spanish Supreme Court ordered the provisional suspension of registration in CERA for descendants of exiles who acquired Spanish nationality under the 2022 Democracy Memory Law, consequently suspending their right to vote. The measure requires impartial analysis, free from political polarization.

item.title: ¿'Lawfare’ o pucherazo?
item.description: The article discusses political polarization in Brazil, linking it to issues such as the grandchildren's law and restrictions on voting rights of naturalized citizens, criticizing the loss of maturity in public debates. It questions whether the situation constitutes lawfare or electoral manipulation (pucherazo).

item.title: Organograma cita “Mário” como sócio de produtora de “Dark Horse” nos EUA
item.description: A document seized by the São Paulo Civil Police during the Wi-Fi Livre SP operation indicates a person named Mário as a partner of the U.S.-based production company Go Up Entertainment, responsible for the film 'Dark Horse' about former president Jair Bolsonaro. The document, linked to Karina Ferreira da Gama—who leads the Instituto Conhecer Brasil and is a partner of Go Up in Brazil—raises suspicions of irregular political funding, particularly involving parliamentary amendments and resources from businessman Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Eleição vai para a prorrogação
item.description: Quaest poll shows Lula leading the first round with 36% against 29% for Flávio, tying at 41% each in the second round. Both face high rejection rates (53% for Lula and 55% for Flávio). The race remains open with no definitive outcome yet.

item.title: VÍDEO: Como consultar o horário e local de votação?
item.description: The content explains how to find voting time and location for the 2026 elections using tools such as the TSE self-service and the e-title app. The G1 series of 50 videos covers topics like how voting works, contested positions and the impact of technologies on campaigns. Voting takes place from 8am to 5pm Brasília time, with adjustments according to the local timezone of each region.

item.title: Impeachment de juízes de supremas cortes é raridade em democracias pelo mundo
item.description: Suspicion surrounding Alexandre de Moraes in the Banco Master case renews debates about impeachment at the STF. Across democracies, removing supreme court judges is rare and institutionally sensitive.

item.title: Precisamos ressuscitar o STF, diz o ex-ministro da Justiça José Carlos Dias
item.description: Former Minister of Justice José Carlos Dias, 87, says the STF needs to be revived to strengthen democracy and human rights. Though retired after over 60 years of practice, he remains engaged in the causes he has long defended.

item.title: Sessão sobre crise no STF tem rito incerto, artilharia montada entre Moraes e Mendonça e risco de obstrução
item.description: The STF faces an unprecedented crisis in the Master case, with uncertain proceedings and risk of obstruction, as ministers Moraes and Mendonça lead rival factions in an intense dispute.

item.title: Caetano Veloso declara novamente apoio a Lula para presidente
item.description: Caetano Veloso reiterated his support for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva during a show in the Federal District, making the 'L' gesture and saying 'go, Lula'. First Lady Janja Lula and other artists, including Chico Buarque and Maria Bethânia, also expressed support for the PT candidate in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Roberta Luchsinger pede que produtora de “Dark Horse” não seja julgada
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger asked that producer Karina Gama, investigated in the 'Dark Horse' funding case, not be prematurely judged by public opinion. The businesswoman emphasized defense of rights and guarantees, without taking a stance on the producer's responsibility. The investigations involve irregular INSS discounts and use of parliamentary amendments.
